name: lever lying two-one leg curl
description: A lying machine leg curl that starts with both legs and finishes with one. It targets the hamstrings with a controlled, heavier lowering phase.
instructions: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad just above your heels and your knees just past the bench.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl the pad up toward your glutes with both legs.
Take one leg off the pad and lower the weight slowly with the other.
Curl up with both legs again and lower with the other leg next time.
